message: There was a login disruption arising from one-time password (OTP). The system had resumed normal operations on 2026-11-13 21:45.  We are closely monitoring system stability to ensure continued reliability. We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.  我們的系統登入一次密碼（OTP）發送曾經出現暫時中斷，系統的服務已於 2026-11-13 21:45 回復正常。我們密切關注系統情況，確保其穩定運作。我們對是次事故造成的不便深表歉意，並感謝您的體諒。We are currently experiencing login issues in particular one-time password (OTP).  Our technical team is actively working on a resolution.  We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused.  A progress update will be provided by 10:00 a.m., Saturday 14 Nov 2026.  我們的系統登入一次密碼（OTP）發送服務出現暫時中斷。我們的技術團隊正全力進行修復。我們對由此造成的不便深表歉意。 我們將在 2026年11月14日 星期六上午 10 時提供最新進展 。
